items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Zentralen Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland.
items.computation: The envelope copy (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) shows 'zugestellt am 21.11.2026' — formal service, so the actual service date is used, not the 4-day deemed-delivery rule for ordinary post. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service (21.11.2026, a Saturday) is not counted; the 2-week period (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) would run out on Sat 05.12.2026. Since that is a Saturday, under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Mon 07.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the fine (total Gesamtbetrag) after the decision becomes final
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00.
items.computation: Payment is only due once the Bußgeldbescheid is rechtskräftig (final), i.e. only if no Einspruch is filed by the deadline above (07.12.2026); Rechtskraft then occurs the next day, 08.12.2026. Counting 2 weeks from there under §§ 187/188 BGB (day of Rechtskraft not counted, period runs 2 weeks) gives Tue 22.12.2026, which is a business day so no further shift applies. This date only holds if no Einspruch is lodged; filing an Einspruch removes this payment obligation and restarts the proceedings.

warnings: The payment deadline (22.12.2026) is conditional: it only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026 and the Bescheid becomes final; filing an Einspruch removes the payment obligation for now.

The IBAN DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00 is well-formed and German, but a well-formed IBAN does not prove ownership — compare it with other official communications from this authority before paying, and note the sender's own listed bank name is 'Landesmusterbank', which is unusual for a public authority and worth double-checking.

The sender's contact email domain contains a non-ASCII character ('zentrale-bußgeldbehörde-beis.example') and the whole letterhead uses an '.example' domain and placeholder-style place names (Beispielbrücke, Beispielwadern, Beispielsaarland), suggesting this may be a template/sample document rather than a genuine authority letter — verify the sender independently before paying or relying on the dates.
